fact: On 5 November 2019 the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection handed over a new paper custody register (registre de garde à vue) for the investigation units of the national police and gendarmerie, designed under the EU-funded Programme d'Appui au Secteur de la Justice, together with a first lot of SIPAO/WAPIS computer equipment valued at 36 million CFA francs; the SIPAO memorandum between INTERPOL and the Togolese government was signed on 14 March 2019.
title: CÉRÉMONIE DE REMISE DES REGISTRES DE GARDE À VUE ET DU PREMIER LOT DE MATÉRIELS DU PROGRAMME SIPAO/WAPIS
publisher: Ministère de la Sécurité et de la Protection civile
